# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow must list the same patterns in the same order
# (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file that can change a job's result is listed: a missing one skips the job on a
# change that alters it

src/**
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock

rust-toolchain.toml

tests/exhaustive_f32.rs
scripts/exhaustive_count.py
scripts/test_exhaustive_count.py
scripts/run_tests.sh
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/exhaustive-f32.yml
.github/paths/exhaustive-f32.txt
